title: AI and Automation Contractor
summary: Designed and deployed AI powered automations for a fitness and Pilates startup, covering email workflows, customer review processing, data management, and user registration. I translated the company's operational needs into production workflows that, by the company's own estimate, returned more than two hundred hours each month and close to nine thousand dollars a year.

title: AI and Automation Contractor
summary: Developed and deployed AI powered automations on Google Cloud that streamlined core business processes. The systems generated an estimated eight thousand dollars in recurring annual savings, and taught me how much quiet value sits inside work that no one wants to do by hand.

title: Project Manager, Youth Innovation Program
summary: Selected through The Knowledge Society to work with Interac's Innovation team on a personalized payments experience for Gen Z. I led product strategy, ran sprint planning and weekly mentor reviews, designed the user flows and Figma prototype, and built an agentic AI assistant with real decision logic using Python and the OpenAI API. We presented the final prototype and business case to Interac mentors in person.

title: Software Engineering, AI and Automation Intern
summary: Worked full time on a technical team at a fast moving startup, pioneering Othership's first serious use of AI and automation. I built and deployed production systems that saved more than twelve thousand dollars and three hundred hours a year, including an account auto merging workflow now processing over one hundred and fifty thousand accounts annually, an AI customer support bot, and a lease analyser pipeline built on GPT and RAG.

title: Senior Cadet, Instructor and Teacher
summary: Served as a Senior Cadet in the 132 Spitfire Squadron, teaching aviation, military ethos, leadership, project management, and flight physics to a group of roughly thirty cadets. The classroom taught me that clarity is a form of respect, and that impromptu speaking is a skill you earn rather than inherit.
